# ShadowingKit
> Spanish speaking practice app using the shadowing technique. 100+ native-speaker episodes with synchronized text highlighting. iOS app for A2-B2 learners.

## About
- [Landing Page](https://shadowingkit.com): App overview, features, how it works, FAQ
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6476920610): Download on iOS

## Start Here
- [Spanish Shadowing Technique](https://shadowingkit.com/what-is-shadowing/): Complete guide to the shadowing technique for Spanish learners
- [Spanish Shadowing for Beginners](https://shadowingkit.com/spanish-shadowing-for-beginners/): A2-targeted step-by-step entry guide

## Why Spanish Speaking Is Hard
- [Why You Understand Spanish But Can't Speak It](https://shadowingkit.com/understand-spanish-cant-speak/): Production freeze and how to fix it
- [Why Can't I Speak Spanish? 5 Reasons](https://shadowingkit.com/why-not-speaking-spanish/): Five barriers to fluency and the fix
- [How to Stop Translating in Your Head](https://shadowingkit.com/stop-translating-in-your-head-spanish/): Bypass the mental translation step
- [Breaking the Intermediate Spanish Plateau](https://shadowingkit.com/spanish-fluency-plateau/): B1-B2 stuck-point and the breakthrough
- [Spanish Speaking Anxiety](https://shadowingkit.com/spanish-speaking-anxiety/): Practice without pressure
- [How to Practice Spanish Speaking Alone](https://shadowingkit.com/practice-spanish-speaking-alone/): Solo speaking practice methods

## Method Comparisons
- [Shadowing vs Duolingo for Speaking Spanish](https://shadowingkit.com/shadowing-vs-duolingo/): Vocabulary vs production
- [Shadowing vs Pimsleur](https://shadowingkit.com/shadowing-vs-pimsleur/): Pause-respond vs simultaneous speech
- [Shadowing vs Spanish Conversation Classes](https://shadowingkit.com/shadowing-vs-conversation-classes/): When to use each
- [Shadowing vs Immersion](https://shadowingkit.com/shadowing-vs-immersion/): Immersion benefits without moving abroad
- [Duolingo Alternatives for Speaking Spanish](https://shadowingkit.com/duolingo-alternatives-for-speaking-spanish/): Alternatives matched to the skill you're missing
